description.en:
Enhances the very weak default Force Feedback of Farming Simulator 25 on Linux/CachyOS.
This mod is the in-game half of a two-part system: it captures per-frame vehicle telemetry (steering angle, velocity, per-wheel tire forces, suspension compression, ground material, pitch/roll, collisions, attached implement mass, engine RPM) and writes it to a shared file that the companion Linux daemon reads. The daemon then drives the steering wheel directly via /dev/input/eventX, producing richer FFB than the GIANTS engine emits on its own.
Target hardware: Moza R5/R9 (primary) and any other evdev FFB-capable wheel.
No effect is applied unless the daemon is running, so the mod is safe to leave installed on a dedicated server or when playing without the wheel.
description.de: Verbessert das schwache Force Feedback von Farming Simulator 25 unter Linux/CachyOS durch eine externe Rust-Komponente, die direkt über evdev auf das Lenkrad zugreift.
